baseline._modes: tokens | derived | internal. 'derived' diffs every element against inputs/tokens.json, exported from live Figma variables (get_variable_defs). Falls back to 'internal' if TG has no token variables.

notes: Admin portal uses email->OTP login (dev OTP 123456) under the 'Admin' role tab. Emails + OTP are NOT stored here; they live in projects/tg/secrets.json (gitignored), keyed by role, plus a shared _otp. User/citizen portal (tg-user-dev.mosje.in) is DigiLocker/Aadhaar-oriented with no working email-OTP citizen login yet -> coverage debt, not audited.
